newsitem.title: USA: Glickan to co-chair panel at US-Mexico meeting.
newsitem.headline: Glickan to co-chair panel at US-Mexico meeting.

text.p: Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman and his Mexican counterpart will be co-chairs of a working group on agricultural issues at next week's U.S.-Mexico Binational Commission meeting, the Agriculture Department said Friday.
The meeting will be held Monday through Wednesday in Mexico City.
Glickman said earlier this week that he wanted to raise the issues of fruit sales, karnal bunt fungus in wheat, and trade in pork and cattle during the trip.
Francisco Labastida Ochoa, the Mexican agriculture secretary, and Glickman will present a report on the working group's accomplishments as part of the commission meeting.
In addition, Glickman and Environment Secretary Julia Carabias were scheduled to sign a memorandum of understanding on Monday for cooperation in promoting sustainable development.
On Tuesday, Glickman was to visit the International Center for Improvement of Corn and Wheat on the outskirts of Mexico City. The center played a key role in the Green Revolution.
Mexico is the third largest market for U.S. agricultural exports and the No 1 market for Mexico's ag sales. U.S. shipments totaled $5.4 billion last year.
